sentences.text:
Order
This petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India has been filed seeking the following reliefs :-
(i) Issue a writ of Mandamus commanding the respondent no.1 and 2 to deposit the award amount Rs.2,50,2522 of Village Ubra and Rs.1,11,13,461/- of Village Kuteshwar total Rs.3,61,15983 in P.D. no.200/P.D/200/1203/1- 123 of Collector and District Land Acquisition Officer, Katni, in the interest of justice.
(ii) Issue a writ of Mandamus commanding the respondent no. 3 to make the payment of compensation amount tot he petitioners with 12% interest in stipulated time period.
(iii) Any other relief deems fit may also be granted including cost of litigation.
(2) It is submitted by counsel for the petitioners that in spite of an award passed in his favour, the compensation amount has not been released.
However, fairly conceded that copy of award has not been filed.

(3) It is submitted that he has already applied under the Right to Information Act and, therefore,
seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this petition with liberty to file a properly constituted fresh petition along with copy of award to show that he is entitled for compensation.
(4) With aforesaid liberty, petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
